description: Every active Security Hub control failure (CIS 3.0.0 and FSBP) is remediated or in the exception record, each exception with its reason and a review date not yet passed; the pass rate across evaluated controls is recorded. Disabled controls are recorded in securityhub_controls.tf

exceptions.reason: Session keys (database until 2026-10-02, secrets, logs) are scheduled for deletion at every teardown by design: they encrypt what the teardown destroys. The persistent keys are carved out, so one of them scheduled for deletion fails.
Object-level write events are logged for the customer-data store only, by the 2026-09-05 MLA-LET cost decision; the trail's selectors are checked by mla-let-cfg-aws-trail-data-events-scoped.
Object-level read events: as S3.22, the 2026-09-05 MLA-LET decision.
There are no EC2 instances or EKS clusters: the workloads run on Fargate, and posture.tf records the EC2 and EKS add-ons as deliberately off (EKS audit logs).

The operator's Identity Center role (InterimOperatorAdmin) holds AWS Support access; a separate support role would be a second standing identity for a two-person team. Decided 2026-10-03.
Detection reads the trail from S3 through Athena and the normalized corpus, not CloudWatch Logs; integrating it would duplicate the stream and its cost. Decided 2026-10-03.

Server access logging is not enabled: customer-data object access is recorded as CloudTrail data events (the 2026-09-05 MLA-LET scope), and the other buckets hold logs, state and scratch output. Decided 2026-10-03.
As S3.9, for the trail's own bucket: its writes are CloudTrail's, and reads of it are confined to four declared readers by bucket policy. Decided 2026-10-03.
MFA delete can be set only by the root user through the API. The log store's Object Lock in COMPLIANCE mode is stronger: nobody can delete a locked version, root included. Decided 2026-10-03.
The one customer-data store holds synthetic measurements, classified by design; Macie bills per bucket and per byte scanned for a classification the design already made. Decided 2026-10-03.
The two Lambdas are first-party code using only the runtime's boto3, with no packaged dependencies to scan; their source is reviewed in the repository. Decided 2026-10-03.
As Inspector.3: no packaged dependencies. Decided 2026-10-03.
